title: Claude Code Global User Configuration (~/.claude.json)
description: Persisted global user config/state file for Claude Code CLI. Current builds prefer ~/.claude/.config.json and fall back to legacy ~/.claude.json. This schema models the persisted global file (auth state, UI preferences, caches, usage counters, IDs, and nested per-project state) and intentionally excludes the separately merged settings.json/project/policy configuration.
$comment: Reverse-engineered from cli.unpack.js v2.1.154 using DEFAULT_GLOBAL_CONFIG (zr() factory at line 173988, assigned to Yr at line 174874), GLOBAL_CONFIG_KEYS (F66 at line 174875), PROJECT_CONFIG_KEYS (FU9 at line 174876, now ["allowedTools","hasTrustDialogAccepted","hasCompletedProjectOnboarding"]), NOTIFICATION_CHANNELS (AF_ at line 67222), EDITOR_MODES (wF_ at line 67223), TEAMMATE_MODES (vvq at line 67224), theme enum (pr6 at line 67225, with auto-prefixed Br6 at line 67226), and MCP transport enum (sse-ide/ws-ide/sdk/claudeai-proxy confirmed present around lines 67756-67834 and 331485-331491). All keys in DEFAULT_GLOBAL_CONFIG and GLOBAL_CONFIG_KEYS verified against the v2.1.154 bundle. Delta v2.1.146→v2.1.154: one new key added, unpinOpus48LaunchEffort (DEFAULT_GLOBAL_CONFIG default false, the Opus 4.8 companion to unpinOpus47LaunchEffort); all enums (theme, notification channels, editor modes, teammate modes, MCP transports) unchanged; remaining differences are identifier renames only (e.g. wn→zr/Yr, Ca_→F66, av9→FU9, Xx_→AF_). Symbol names are minified and shift every release; per-field line-number citations in property descriptions were authored against earlier tags and are approximate version-specific evidence pointers, not stable anchors.
